shared.klass: Class: one small clump of trees for a strategy map: three to five trees standing close together as one free-standing cut-out, calmer and less saturated than units, simple shapes, no face. It stands on the empty transparent background with nothing drawn under it: no ground, no grass, no soil.

recipes.subject: Subject: a jungle clump: two leaning palm trees, one squat cycad and giant fern fronds; lush deep greens (#2f7d45, #4fa55a) with yellow-green highlights and brown ringed trunks; the outline is a dark green tone, never pure black.
recipes.notes: Sample: the jungle clump, styled from the default Forest clump so scale, outline and softness match.
recipes.review: Four jungle clumps of palms, a cycad and fern fronds, deep greens, dark green outline, at the default clump's scale. 0 (61 x 65), 1 (78 x 59) and 3 (74 x 66) are the set's clumps. 2 measures lit from the right (faces -2.2) and is left out.

recipes.subject: Subject: a clump of alien growths, not trees: four tall red-ochre fungal stalks and spires of different heights (#b06a48, shade #7f4634) with rounded teal caps (#3f9c93, light #6fc4b6) and small teal bulbs at the foot; no leaves, no green; the outline is a dark red-brown tone, never pure black.
recipes.notes: Sample: the alien growths without a style image, because the default clump's green palette would be copied.
recipes.review: Four clumps of red-ochre fungal stalks with teal caps and teal bulbs at the foot; all lit from the left (faces +13.7 to +30.5). 0, 1 and 3 are the set's clumps; 2 is 88 px tall, over the 86 a clump may be.

recipes.subject: Subject: a clump of four dead and dying trees: bare crooked grey-brown trunks and branches, two with thin dark blue-green crowns and a few pale yellow-grey leaves; gloomy dusk colours (canopy #4f5f5a, bark #6b5d55, leaves #c9c79a); the outline is a dark tone, never pure black.
recipes.notes: Dead and dying trees, styled from the default Forest clump.
recipes.review: Bare crooked trunks, two with thin dark crowns and pale leaves: the look. Only 3 (75 x 83) fits well and is a clump of the set; 1 is 71 x 86, 0 is 102 px tall and 2 is 87: over or at the 86 px a clump may be.

recipes.subject: Subject: a scrubby thicket: two crooked half-dead trees with sparse olive-yellow leaves, thorn bushes of dry brown twigs and one sawn tree stump; dry olive and straw colours (#8a8f3e, #b5a85a, bark #6b5133); the outline is a dark tone, never pure black.
recipes.notes: Scrub, thorn and a stump, styled from the default Forest clump.
recipes.review: Four clumps of crooked half-dead trees, dry twig bushes and sawn stumps in olive, straw and brown; none lit from the right (faces -0.1 to +8.0). All four are the set's clumps.

recipes.subject: Subject: three sturdy dark pine trees (#2f5a45, light #3f7355) with thick brown trunks, standing among two mossy grey boulders (#8d9488, moss #6f8a55); the outline is a dark tone, never pure black.
recipes.notes: Dark pines among mossy boulders, styled from the default Forest clump.
recipes.review: Dark pines with thick trunks among mossy grey boulders. 0, 1 and 3 are the set's clumps (faces -0.2 to +4.5); 2 is 78 x 84 with the pines cut close to the image edge and is left out.

recipes.subject: Subject: a clump of sweet trees: chocolate-brown trunks (#5a3a28) with round mint-green (#8fd4b0) and cream-white candy-floss canopies, and one small striped lollipop as an accent; mostly mint, cream and chocolate, very little pink; the outline is a dark chocolate tone, never pure black.
recipes.notes: Sweet trees without a style image: the palette is the faction's, not the Forest's.
recipes.review: Chocolate trunks under round mint and cream canopies, two with swirls, each clump with a small lollipop: mint, cream and chocolate, no pink. 0 and 1 are clumps of the set. 2 and 3 measure lit from the right (faces -2.6 and -9.8): the cream canopies stand on the right, which the measure reads as light from that side; they are left out all the same. Superseded: bead pulp_wars-2yc.13 replaced the sweet trees with the candy grove of candy-c, -d and -e; no candidate of this recipe is used now.

recipes.subject: Subject: a low candy grove, not trees: one striped candy cane with a hooked top (cream, brick-red stripes), two round swirl lollipops on thin sticks (caramel and cream; dusty raspberry and cream), one chocolate stick (#5a3a28) and low gumdrop bushes at the foot (caramel #c98f52, raspberry #b8667a); muted colours, no mint green, no bright pink; outline a dark chocolate tone, never black.
recipes.notes: Bead pulp_wars-2yc.13 (the user, 2026-10-06: candy canes and lollipops and such). Sample: the candy grove without a style image, the palette the faction's chocolate, caramel and cream.
recipes.review: Four candy groves, no trees: striped canes, caramel and raspberry swirl lollipops, chocolate sticks, gumdrops at the foot; muted caramel, raspberry, cream and chocolate, no mint, no pink-on-white. 0 (61 x 78, faces +0.4) and 1 (56 x 73, +0.8) are clumps of the set. 2 measures lit from the right (-2.9: the raspberry lollipop stands left of the paler caramel one, which the measure reads as light) and is left out. 3 is three canes and two chocolate sticks: fine alone, but packed it made the pieces a thicket of red stripes, so it is left out.

recipes.subject: Subject: a low candy grove, the same sweets and colours as the style image: two big round swirl lollipops on thin sticks (caramel and cream; dusty raspberry and cream), one short chocolate stick and a row of big plain gumdrop bushes at the foot (caramel, raspberry, cream); big calm shapes, few stripes, no candy cane; every sweet lighter on its left side; no mint green, no bright pink.
recipes.notes: Bead pulp_wars-2yc.13. Batch: calmer clumps of big lollipops and gumdrop bushes, styled from candy-c-1, because three striped canes in one clump made the packed pieces busy.
recipes.review: Four calmer groves in the same hand: two big lollipops over gumdrops, with chocolate sticks. 0 (49 x 73, faces -1.5 rounded, inside the bake's limit) is a clump of the set. 1 has two cut chocolate rolls that read as logs; 2 (-7.3) and 3 (-1.5, past the limit) measure lit from the right, and 3 is also a thin clump. Left out.

recipes.subject: Subject: a low candy grove, the same sweets and colours as the style image: one thick chocolate stick trunk with a big round caramel swirl sweet on top, one striped candy cane beside it, one small raspberry lollipop, and big plain gumdrop bushes at the foot (caramel, raspberry, cream); big calm shapes; every sweet lighter on its left side; no mint green, no bright pink.
recipes.notes: Bead pulp_wars-2yc.13. Batch: a chocolate-stick trunk with a swirl sweet, one cane and gumdrop bushes, styled from candy-c-0.
recipes.review: 0: a chocolate trunk under a big caramel swirl, the best single shape, but it measures -6.4 (dark trunk left of pale gumdrops) and the bake refuses it. 1: three canes, busy, -6.7. 2 (+8.8) is nearly candy-c-0 again. 3 (69 x 84, +17.5): a thick chocolate-stick trunk, a lollipop each side, a plain cane and big gumdrops, drawn a little larger than the others; it is the set's fourth clump.
